phenotype.definition: Head or face pain on some days or more in the past 3 months (PAIHDFC3M_A 2-4; 'never had any pain' counts as no) AND any hearing difficulty even with a hearing aid (HEARINGDF_A 2-4). All adults 18+; complete cases only. Narrower than the 2023 artifact: NHIS 2019 fielded no dizziness/balance or tinnitus item, so the otologic arm is hearing only; no sinonasal or recalcitrance arm.

questionText.headache_migraine: PAIHDFC3M_A, NHIS pain module (odd years), pain-location item for head or face ('HDFC'), 'how often in the past 3 months': 1 never, 2 some days, 3 most days, 4 every day. Positive = some days or more. Asked only of adults reporting any pain in the past 3 months (PAIFRQ3M_A = 2-4); a 'never' at that gate counts as no. Broader than NHANES MPQ090 'severe headaches or migraines': this item has no severity qualifier, so prevalence is not comparable to NHANES without the sensitivity run described in the map note.
questionText.hearing_difficulty: HEARINGDF_A, Washington Group short set, 'difficulty hearing, even when using a hearing aid': 1 no difficulty, 2 some difficulty, 3 a lot of difficulty, 4 cannot do at all. Positive = some difficulty or more. Asked of all adults every year.

caveats: Screening-level phenotype prevalence, not diagnosed prevalence. No vestibular-testing or ICHD/Barany reference standard exists in these data.
Self-reported survey items; coding inconsistency may bias phenotype capture.
Hypothesis-generating estimate, not a diagnostic count.
Respondents coded Refused / Not Ascertained / Don't Know on a phenotype item are excluded from the denominator, never counted as negative.
Complete-case phenotype: a respondent missing any item the rule uses is excluded from the denominator.
Concepts this cycle could not express: dizziness_balance, tinnitus, sinus_condition, recalcitrance_proxy. The phenotype reported here is narrower than the one defined in proposal 7.1.
No gender-identity item in this cycle: estimates are stratified by sex only. Gender is not substituted from sex.
